title: Localization costs and information growth for exact Gaussian observations

abstractEnglish: For the image of a uniform cube under a spherical coordinate map, we prove that finite messages from t blocks of $`\Theta(d)`$ exact Gaussian measurements reveal only $`O_A(dt)`$ information when each message has at most $`\exp(Ad^2)`$ values, for fixed A. The same bound holds when each message is supplemented with a nested cell that restores the required geometric spread.
titleEn: Localization costs and information growth for exact Gaussian observations
titleZh: 精确高斯观测的局部化代价与信息增长

details.overview: 稿件研究球坐标映射下均匀立方体像的精确高斯观测信息量：作者声称来自t个块、每块Θ(d)个精确高斯测量的有限消息，在每条消息至多exp(Ad²)个取值（A固定）时只揭示O_A(dt)信息；当每条消息附加一个恢复所需几何散布的嵌套单元时，同界仍成立。这刻画了局部化消息对信息增长的限制，摘要未给证明细节，结论待独立审查。
